reviews.review: While it may not be a revolutionary game Space Marine does have great Graphics, an interesting story, tight combat and controls, and, most importantly for fans of the source material, it gets it right. I really enjoy this game and will definitely be playing it many times over

The main game is fun enough if you are a warhammer fan.  The multiplayer is fun too!  It does get repeatative after you unlock everything, though.

Nostalgia, nostalgia, nostalgia. As a huge 40k fan in my childhood, I don’t know why it took me so long to play this game. Has been in my library for about 2 years and just never played it. Boy, was I missing out. 

The game plays similar to Prototype, but much simpler controls for use on a keyboard. The story line is nice, I wasn’t a big follower of 40k lore, but that didn’t matter, you get caught up on everything fairly quickly and I came out the end knowing that little bit more about the Warhammer universe. 
 
The game’s length is just about right;  it does however leaves open ends to the story which could lead to a sequel which would be nice.  If you are a fan of the 40k series, this game is certainly worth a go, I loved seeing all of the different races and army’s come into life, Orcs, undead, Chaos, all there. Not sure how much someone would get out of it if they weren’t a fan of the series though – might just be a run of the mill hack-n-slash to them. 

Still, recommend a play through for what it costs.
